title: GTA 6 for Xbox: How to Save $10 Today Only
description: Xbox owners can save $10 on Grand Theft Auto 6's ultimate edition using a simple workaround, available today only according to IGN Games.

content:
## Save $10 on GTA 6 Xbox Ultimate Edition Today

As anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to reach fever pitch, players across all platforms are constantly looking for ways to secure their copies ahead of launch. Recently, a report from IGN Games highlighted a notable opportunity for Xbox owners: a simple workaround that allows players to save $10 on the ultimate edition of Grand Theft Auto 6, though the offer is strictly available today only.

### Understanding the Limited-Time Offer

According to the details shared by IGN Games, this pricing workaround is designed specifically for Xbox users looking to purchase the ultimate edition of GTA 6. In the current gaming landscape where major AAA titles maintain rigid pricing structures, even a modest $10 reduction can be quite appealing for dedicated fans planning to jump into the next-generation open-world experience right away. Because the window of opportunity is restricted to a single day, timely action is essential for anyone hoping to take advantage of it.

### The Value of Next-Gen Editions

Edition tiers for massive releases like GTA 6 often divide the community, with many weighing the extra cost of ultimate and collector's editions against the included digital or physical bonuses. For Xbox Series X|S players, having a method to shave $10 off the top makes the ultimate edition a slightly more approachable purchase. However, as with all limited-time workarounds and promotional windows, verifying the terms directly on the platform before completing the transaction remains a sensible precaution.

## Editor's Take

It is always interesting to see how pricing opportunities emerge around monumental releases like GTA 6. While a $10 saving might not completely alter your gaming budget, any discount on an ultimate edition is a welcome surprise in today's market. If you are an Xbox owner set on diving into the game's highest tier, checking out this method reported by IGN Games before the day ends is definitely worth considering.
